data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Integrate Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create various data visualizations such as line, bar, area, pie, and radar charts.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with appropriate charts.
Interactive elements and animations are included in charts.

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs to display live metrics.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown using a line chart.
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight Artemis capabilities including pipeline stages, cost tracking, and integration.
acceptance_criteria: Include a HERO slide explaining Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
Visualize an 8-stage pipeline using Chart.js.
Demonstrate cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning features with charts.

features.title: Display Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent Artemis runs to demonstrate effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Actual data from recent runs is used in visualizations.
Metrics are clearly presented and easy to understand.
Data is up-to-date and relevant to the presentation.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics Display
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Metrics are accurate and based on recent data.
Chart is interactive and visually engaging.

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file that includes embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for visualization.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js library is included for data visualization.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show integration of supervisor across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration.
Data is clearly labeled and easy to interpret.
Chart is interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls for manual progression.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate through slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Implement Professional Design
features.description: Design the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied consistently across slides.
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
Overall design is visually impressive and cohesive.
